name: lt02-rescue-neglected-seed

fort.note: Seeds are world seeds; a seed whose embark finds no acceptable site is skipped, so a pool is the first n accepted seeds of its range. test-private seeds are drawn per season by the maintainers and never written into the repo (embark/pool_task.py --split test-private).

brief: You are taking over a neglected fortress: no workshops, no drink, unhappy dwarves.
goal: From day 69 you can't act for 21 days. Keep drink in stock every day of that window, with your own built Still and a planted farm plot, and keep food in stock every day of that window too. No dwarf may die.
description: Seed-built LT02 (docs/SEED-FORTS.md). A neglected fort (embark/forts/neglected-y1: about 18 dwarves, nothing built, no manager or automation, no drink or plants, 11 unhappy dwarves); 21-day hands-off window from day 69.
provenance: Start: embark/forts/neglected-y1.json on a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark of each pool seed (embark/make_task_fort.sh), in place of the noop-y1 snapshot. No setup, as lt02-rescue-neglected.

legacy.note: The snapshot-based task stays as it was (lab-2.0, dfbench/v2.1.1 results); this one is its seed-built successor with a new task hash.
